stemMd: A paragraph explains the technical challenges of restoring a clock; the next describes public fundraising for the work. Which sentence best links the paragraphs?

options.label: B
options.textMd: The clock face includes Roman numerals.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Clocks measure time in several ways.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Meeting these repair challenges required funds that the museum did not yet have.

explanationMd: The link must point backward to difficult repairs and forward to raising money. The need for funds supplies that relationship.

distractorRationale.b: A visual detail does not motivate the shift to fundraising.
distractorRationale.a: Personal preference does not link repairs with funding.
distractorRationale.c: This general statement leaves the transition to fundraising unexplained.
